responsibility: Defines the Bison parser for COBOL compiler-directive statements such as >>DEFINE, conditional compilation expressions, and TURN exception directives. It owns the CDF symbol dictionary of numeric/string values, parses and evaluates directive expressions into cdfval_t values, coordinates conditional-scanning state with the main lexer, and applies directive effects such as predefined -D names and exception enable/disable requests that influence later parsing and code generation.
